name: Balenyà (Spain)
description: Yellow field with the black eagle's head of the arms in the hoist third and three horizontal rows of six red lozenges touching the upper, lower and fly edges in the other two thirds.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 23 September 1999; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the black eagle's head of the arms (the arms of the Balenyà family, lords of the fortified house of Balenyà) at the centre of the first vertical third and three horizontal rows of six red lozenges in the other two thirds.

features.role: three rows of six juxtaposed lozenges
